5

6
➢ How do I read this sheet?

7
Team Compositions

8
➢ Teams are simply arranged based on Trekker release order.
➢ The first Trekker listed in each team composition is always considered the Main Slot Trekker.
➢ The second Trekker is usually the primary Support Slot Trekker.
➢ The remaining Trekkers are candidates for the final Support Slot, listed in order of their effectiveness for the team.
➢ Trekkers with universal buff effect will not be included unless they offer exceptional value as an alternative option. This is done to reduce the clutter with how much team compositions there are.

*Exception:
- Some team compositions require both Support Slot Trekkers as mandatory picks. In these cases, only the last listed Trekker is flexible and may be swapped out if they are needed for another team.

9
Main Discs

10
Main Disc priorities are determined by overall team utility with these specific Crescendo criteria in mind:

• C1 for Limited, Standard, and Finale Echoing Discs
• C6 for Cataclysm and Event Discs

About Support Discs
You will usually choose Discs that provide the highest relevant stat for the team. Of course, it is best if it also matches the note requirements of your Main Discs but only think of this when we have more Disc options.

Typically, the stats you are looking for are:
• Base ATK
• Elemental DMG%
• AA/Skill DMG%

11
Emblems

12
➢ All emblem affixes are based on the highest rarity.
➢ Emblem affixes with GREEN background indicate that they are the best emblem affix to go for in that slot.
➢ Affixes are ordered by priority from most important (top) to least important (bottom).
➢ Having an Elemental PEN stat of any rarity for your DPS is always better than having none, but do not lock PEN below Gold or Rainbow rarity.

13
Potentials

14
➢ The recommendations are based on maxed out Monolith Research and Ascension Difficulty 8.
➢ All Potentials are arranged based on acquisition and level upgrade priority.
➢ Level 1: Safe to not upgrade past the base level
➢ Level 1+: Upgrade the Potential as much as you can if possible
➢ Level 6: Always upgrade the Potential to its maximum level

*For specific questions, go to the #help-and-advice channel of Stella Sora Official server.

Chaton (5★) | 1+/10/1/1+ (Main Skill >> Auto Attack = Ultimate)

28

Chaton's Dark Ray build is executed by tapping her Main Skill to activate Dark Ray, shooting a laser and inflicting Dark Mark on targets hit. This effect deals Skill DMG every 2 seconds, which can be cut down in half with Meowth's Curse potential.

★ Key Notes:
• Try to use her skill when she has the most buffs since Dark Mark snapshots Effect type buffs upon application.
• If the stage allows it, you can pre-stack The Cat's Treasure and/or Joyful Gathering's buff by using her skill at least once before engaging in battle.
• If you are using The Cat's Treasure as a Main Disc, only use her Ultimate if: 1) Main Skill is at 6s cooldown or 2) Lucky Bullet resets her skill to prevent losing its stacks.
• Lucky Bullet also affects the Skill DMG dealt by Mark of Darkness.
• Having at least one level of Dominant Firepower enables her to quickly charge everyone's Ultimate.

For Boss Blitz S9 (current season):
• Due to Flavor Dread having 80% Skill DMG Taken as a shill, this build comes off as the better build than the hybrid one.

Sniper Operation (Main Skill) is the core skill for this build. It is a must to max it out as soon as possible since Dark Ray, Dark Mark, and Reincarnation of Darkness' damage scales depending on its skill level.

29

Both Full-Auto Trigger (Auto Attack) and Dark Evil Eye (Ultimate) can be optionally upgraded as well but not as much as her Main Skill, preferably only until Level 7 to help against bosses that summon additional targets.

Flora (4★) | 1/1/10/1 (Support Skill only)

45

Flora is currently the irreplaceable support of this team. The massive buff and debuff utility that she can offer for the team is currently incomparable with other options.

★ Key Notes:
• Regarding Charge Efficiency, getting to 30% CE is probably enough.
• Ashes of the Past offers a better result if the team has little to no Crit Rate.
• Alternatively, Ember of Tomorrow will be used if your Crit Rate is already high.
• Ember Rekindled can enable a permanent uptime for Soulflare Butterfly's debuff assuming that the target has Butterfly Mark.
• Foreshadowing Verification's huge boost in Crit DMG is the main reason why Ignis teams typically rely on critting
• Reinforced Impression offers a lot of Crit Rate gain especially when paired with Ashes of the Past.
• Keep enemies inside her Ultimate to build up Lethal Inferno's debuff stacks and to maintain its uptime.

Only upgrade Flutter Flare (Support Skill) as it increases the Crit DMG given by Mindflare Butterfly.

Keep in mind that the Crit DMG buff does not correlate with the amount of Mindflare Butterflies present.

Fuyuka (5★) | 1/1+/1/10 (Ultimate > Main Skill)

212

Fuyuka's Ultimate-focused build is fully reliant on having fast Energy charging along with maxing out Peak Performance and Ironfist Blow.

Keep in mind that this build is primarily used in endgame single target content like Boss Blitz and Finale Echoing.

★ Key Notes:
• Currently, any rarity of Charge Efficiency is fine on one of her emblems as she is able to pull off four Ultimates even at the lowest rarity.

Blaze Unsealed (Ulitimate) is the main priority to upgrade as it encompasses majority of her damage output thanks to its inherent multipliers that are further strengthened by Peak Performance and Ironfist Blow.

213

Ignis Infusion (Main Skill) is the last priority as it is only used to comfortably bring down the Resilience bar of the boss for her first Ultimate setup. Additionally, Kitty Punch and Multi-Shot also scales with its level.
